About Jaisalmer

The Golden City with a living fort, carved havelis and camel safaris on the Sam sand dunes.

Jaisalmer is in Rajasthan and is best known as a heritage, desert destination. The best time to visit is Oct–Feb, and most travellers spend 2 days here.

The nearest airport is Jaisalmer Airport (JSA, seasonal) / Jodhpur (JDH), and the nearest railhead is Jaisalmer. The closest major city is Jodhpur, about 223 km away as the crow flies.

Day 2Final sights & departure
Visit Sam sand dunes camp, Kuldhara village, Bada Bagh. Try Dal baati for a meal.

How to reach Jaisalmer

By air

Jaisalmer Airport (JSA, seasonal) / Jodhpur (JDH). Pre-book an airport taxi with your package.

By train

Jaisalmer. Book IRCTC tickets early in peak season.

By road

Connected by highways to Jodhpur (~223 km), Udaipur (~383 km), Ahmedabad (~465 km). Distances are straight-line estimates; road distance is longer.

Travel tips for Jaisalmer

  • Start early to beat crowds and heat; many monuments sell online tickets, and some close one day a week.
  • Days are hot and nights cold in the desert — pack sunglasses, a scarf and a warm layer.
  • Carry a government photo ID for every traveller for hotel check-in and entry tickets.

Jaisalmer travel FAQs

What is the best time to visit Jaisalmer?

The best time to visit Jaisalmer is Oct–Feb. Weather is most comfortable for sightseeing in these months.

How many days are enough for Jaisalmer?

2 days are enough to see the main sights of Jaisalmer: Jaisalmer Fort (Sonar Quila), Patwon ki Haveli, Gadisar Lake. Add a day to combine it with nearby places like Jodhpur and Bikaner.

How to reach Jaisalmer?

By air: Jaisalmer Airport (JSA, seasonal) / Jodhpur (JDH). By train: Jaisalmer. By road: Jaisalmer is connected by road to Jodhpur, Udaipur, Ahmedabad; taxis and buses run from the nearest airport and station.

What are the top places to visit in Jaisalmer?

Top places include Jaisalmer Fort (Sonar Quila), Patwon ki Haveli, Gadisar Lake, Sam sand dunes camp, Kuldhara village, Bada Bagh.

What is the famous food of Jaisalmer?

Try Ker sangri, Dal baati. Popular things to buy are Mirror-work textiles, Camel-leather goods.
